0.content:
When Yanfei's parents left on their journey, the adeptus Madame Ping became her caretaker, and Yanfei calls her "Granny". She runs errands for her and gets evasive when Granny might not approve. Granny chides her for working through festivals and notices exactly how long she lingers at food stalls, such as the Grilled Tiger Fish stand (2.4, limited event). Madame Ping says Yanfei's father was never this talkative when he stood beside Rex Lapis, but admits Yanfei knows the city better than any of the adepti.

In 1.5 Granny sent her to gather materials for the Traveler's Serenitea Pot. During the 3.4 Lantern Rite (limited event) Yanfei pestered her for music lessons so they could play a duet. Granny has told her not to explain adepti to outsiders, and Yanfei was very evasive about whether Granny approved her trip to Nod-Krai. Xiangling and Yaoyao are Madame Ping's martial-arts students, so the three often cross paths around her.

1.comment: Yanfei: Her parents and the contract to live happily
1.content:
Yanfei's father is an illuminated beast and adeptus who campaigned with Rex Lapis for a long time. Afterwards he married a mortal merchant, saying Rex Lapis approved and even contributed to the wedding gift. Yanfei's only lifelong contract is the one she signed with her parents, to live happily, and she is proud of her father for it. Once she was grown, her parents left to travel, and he still sends the same Lantern Rite greeting every year. He gave her a steelyard balance said to be a treasure from Rex Lapis that weighs any object's value.

The balance measures value only as it was when Mora was created. It still lists Glaze Lilies as nearly worthless from when they covered Liyue, so it is rarely useful for work, but it reminds her that many things can't be valued by worldly standards. When she asked her father about Zhongli, he seemed evasive, and she decided to find out for herself.

2.comment: Yanfei: A Teapot to Call Home: the Smaragdus Jadeite case
2.content:
Madame Ping needed Smaragdus Jadeite to make the Traveler's Serenitea Pot, and the Chasm was sealed. Yanfei remembered a Snezhnayan client, Krosl, who had asked about the law on rare ores. He had rented supposed Jadeite hairpins to a woman named Zhiqiao and wanted her to pay their full value after they disappeared. Yanfei signed Zhiqiao as a client, gathered affidavits from a stoneworker, a jewellery broker and Dr. Baizhu, and proved the pins held ordinary Smaragdus Nephrite. Under his own contract, Krosl owed ten times the price. Zhiqiao paid Yanfei in real Jadeite.

Her reasoning: genuine Jadeite makes mortals ill, yet Zhiqiao said the pins felt smooth, and she noticed strong traces of Geo energy around Krosl. She told the Traveler that today's Liyue needs legal consultancy far more than adeptal power.

3.comment: Yanfei: Perilous Trail: trapped in the Chasm
3.content:
Archon Quest Interlude, 2.7. Yanfei was executing an old will found inside a book. Its author, "someone of great importance", had given a magic device, the Fantastic Compass, to a person who vanished into the Chasm. She asked the Traveler to say they hadn't seen her, Itto chased her, Yelan arrived, and the ground collapsed, dropping everyone into a hostile, time-suspended space below the Chasm. Yanfei worked out that the space lured people with their fears and imaginations, then used that to find a voice-link to the trapped Xiao and to find the Compass.

Behind the "fear door" she found a messy civil dispute. She briefly activated the Compass with her half-adeptus blood, recalling an old legend that mortal and adeptal power combined can "move the heavens and shake the earth". She proposed that Yelan and Xiao power it together to reverse the seal, and they escaped as Xiao nearly sacrificed himself. Afterward she apologised, offered compensation, and took Itto and Shinobu sightseeing in Liyue Harbor.

In the depths she defeated Treasure Hoarders the space had copied from her memory, thugs once hired by a defendant to attack her. She explained to the Traveler that Yelan, a survivor herself, cannot bear self-sacrifice: "salvation can also be a burden." She promised not to write down anything private she had heard.

4.content:
Yanfei introduces Yelan as someone who works at the Ministry of Civil Affairs and keeps her real role secret. Yelan once helped her crack an accounting fraud case, and Yanfei treated her to dinner. Yanfei admires her but feels Yelan can read her mind and is determined never to get on her bad side. Yelan says she likes Yanfei and the intelligence that flows toward her, and that Yanfei respects her a little too much.

In the Chasm, Yanfei quietly learned Yelan's illusion-breaking method by watching her. Yelan credited her with finding the space's loophole.

5.comment: Yanfei: Kuki Shinobu and the borders-of-law book
5.content:
Shinobu ran away from home and went to study law in Liyue, where she met Yanfei, whom she calls a walking law encyclopedia and "senpai". Yanfei remembers Shinobu bowing to thank her after every case discussion and expected her to make an excellent lawyer. She wondered what happened to her after Inazuma closed its borders. Shinobu later came back to collect her graduation certificate.

By 6.0 the two were co-writing a "universal" law book on the "borders of law": concise, engaging, and covering many nations. One chapter is about what happens when law breaks down entirely, which is why Yanfei went to Nod-Krai.

6.content:
Itto came to Liyue with Shinobu, got into a brawl with the Millelith in a queue, and was about to be arrested when Yanfei walked by and sorted it out. He calls her his savior. Yanfei found him outgoing but had work to do, and dodged him when he chased her toward the Chasm.

In a 4.3 limited-time event, Yanfei arranged the Ministry of Civil Affairs permit for Itto's beetle-battle boot camp in Liyue. She and Xiangling asked Madame Ping's circle about mechanical help, and Shinobu worried about the gang leaning on her too much.

7.content:
While consulting for a merchant ship, Yanfei discovered that Abyss Order cargo disguised as ordinary goods was being shipped from Dornman Port to Liyue Harbor. She investigated and nearly died; Eula's Knights arrived minutes from too late. They have corresponded ever since. Yanfei thinks they get along because both use rules cleverly and flexibly, though she will never have Eula's carefree spirit. Eula admires her smarts and notes that Yanfei owes her a favour.

Yanfei had heard a lot about Amber from Eula, and Amber learned of Yanfei's visit after Yanfei wrote to Eula about it. In Mondstadt (6.2, limited event) Amber ordered rare tofu for her and they camped in the Stormbearer Mountains. Yanfei hopes the four of them, Eula and the Traveler included, can go camping when Eula isn't working overtime.

8.content:
Ningguang wrote Liyue's comprehensive legal compendium and keeps amending it, generating new laws and annotations that Yanfei must memorise. Ningguang calls Yanfei a dear rival: her cunning advice exposes loopholes that would otherwise take the Tianquan months to find. Yanfei refuses to be outdone on law by "a businesswoman at heart". Keqing, who expects Liyue to need legal talent as it changes, would like Yanfei as an assistant. Yanfei is offended at the idea.

In 2.1 (limited event) Yanfei officiated the Qixing's Masterful Chefs final with Ningguang and Keqing as judges. She swore fairness, impartiality and transparency, and, with the judges, accepted Guoba's switch to helping the other contestant.

9.content:
Yanfei calls Zhongli a walking library and a quiet savant, and certainly not a potential client, since he takes on hard problems alone. She keeps feeling she knows him from somewhere. Her father gave an evasive answer, so she suspects he is hiding something. She does not know Zhongli is Rex Lapis.

Zhongli says that despite never signing his contract she upholds order across many levels of Liyue society, and that her father would be even more delighted than he is. At the end of Perilous Trail, Zhongli watched from a cliff and quietly saved Xiao; Yanfei did not see him.

10.content:
Ganyu has known Yanfei since she was a little girl who said you have to keep promises to live happily. Ganyu is relieved to see her grown up and carefree despite complicated work. Yanfei finds Ganyu kind and thoughtful but pities her endless paperwork, interrupted only by her noon nap. She is glad her own chosen job is less taxing.

At the 3.4 Lantern Rite (limited), Ganyu dragged Yanfei off on a made-up Yuehai Pavilion errand, which Madame Ping saw through. At the 6.3 Lantern Rite (limited), they swapped lore about the White Horse Adeptus at the horse-shaped Mingxiao Lantern.

11.content:
Yanfei knows Xiao by title and, through Madame Ping, knows he guards Wangshu Inn. In the Chasm she was the one who reasoned that his voice could reach them through intersecting spaces. She called to him and guided him to break through. When he wanted to leave so he would not endanger them, she told him he was not a burden and begged him to stay. She opposed his plan to spend all his energy getting them out.

Through him she learned of Bosacius, the Yakshas and karma. She had believed the other four Yakshas were all gone from the world.

12.content:
In Anecdote Chronicles (6.0), the Traveler met Yanfei in Nasha Town gathering material for the "borders of law" chapter. She called Nod-Krai "quite literally a lawless land" where the only law is the "Final Defense Manifesto", her fist, and said a legal consultant there would starve. With adeptus blood, she wasn't afraid of bandits and hoped one would accost her so she could interview him. She claimed Granny had agreed, then fled to an "appointment" with the Curatorium of Secrets.

On Hiisi Island, the Frostmoon children Ina and Kari mobbed the "Long-Horned Miss" and asked if she was a Moonchanter like Lauma. Yanfei panicked about hiding her adeptus nature and called the Traveler as her "savior". She had already told Lauma everything; Lauma let her use the Scions' library in exchange for Liyue adeptus stories and praised her for following the rules. Yanfei promised to send copies of the finished book.

13.comment: Yanfei: Lantern Rites and the White Horse Adeptus
13.content:
Limited-time Lantern Rite events. In 2.4 she worked through the festival, then took a holiday after her father's annual letter, and decided to mention the Traveler in her reply. In 3.4 she begged Madame Ping for music lessons. In 5.3 she hurried Yaoyao to Yun Jin's opening show.

At the 6.3 Lantern Rite she told Ganyu she had found a record of a divine envoy on the moon in the Frostmoon library and admitted she was "lowkey obsessed" with the White Horse Adeptus. Paimon introduced "Miss Ziqiao" as a cosplayer of the White Horse Adeptus. Yanfei accepted this, seconded Ganyu's suggestion that Ziqiao see the view from Yujing Terrace, and never learned she had met Zibai herself.

14.content: Limited-time and mail material. She has handled several civil suits in Mondstadt. In 6.2, after a tea-resale mediation, she and Yaoyao visited the Knights of Favonius Library, where she borrowed "The Evolution of Laws in the Northern Continents" for a year. They went on to the Dragonspine challenge, where she met Amber, helped design Amber's snowball game and toured Mondstadt with her. Her birthday letters follow the Traveler through The Steambird. In 2024 she asked for the legal details of their Fontaine trial, and in 2026, in Fontaine on business during Fontinalia, she asked which festival films involve law.
